responseBody.subject: Action Required: Payment Authentication Issue
responseBody.messageBody:
Dear Rajesh Sharma,

We were unable to process your recent payment of ₹14,500.00 due to an authentication failure with your card issuer or bank.

To keep your account active and avoid any service interruptions, please log in to your account portal to re-authenticate the transaction or select an alternative payment method.

If you continue to experience issues, please contact your bank or reach out to our support team for assistance.

Best regards,
RecoverFlow AI Support
responseBody.complianceNotice: This email is an automated payment notification. RecoverFlow AI will never ask for your full card details, passwords, or sensitive financial information via email.
